place_fields.summary: Ruins of Kakati Fort associated with Kittur Rani Chennamma's birthplace and early life.

planning_attributes.description: Historic fort ruins at Kakati, associated with Kittur Rani Chennamma, who was born in Kakati.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Kakati was the birthplace of Kittur Rani Chennamma; the fort is described as largely ruined, with only remnants remaining.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Kakati from Belagavi by road; the fort site is in Kakati village.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The site is in ruins, so take care around uneven or deteriorated structures.
planning_attributes.notes: Historical site with limited surviving fort structures.

place_fields.summary: Ramakrishna Mission Ashrama in Belagavi, established on the site where Swami Vivekananda stayed in 1892 and now serving as a spiritual, educational and community centre.

planning_attributes.description: Ramakrishna Mission Ashrama in Fort, Belagavi, with spiritual programmes, education, healthcare and relief activities.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The Ashrama was started in 2000 on the premises of the house where Swami Vivekananda stayed for nine days in 1892.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The Ashrama is in Fort, Belagavi and can be reached by local road transport.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Maintain silence and follow the Ashrama's visitor and worship-area etiquette.
planning_attributes.notes: The official Ashrama site lists the Fort, Belagavi address and current contact details.

place_fields.summary: Military Mahadeva Temple is a Shiva temple in Belagavi's cantonment area, known for its landscaped gardens, children's park and small zoo.

planning_attributes.description: A Shiva temple in the Belagavi cantonment area with landscaped gardens, a children's park and a small zoo.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The foundation stone was laid on 18 January 1954 and the temple was inaugurated on 24 January 1955.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The temple is on Congress Road (NH-4A) in the Camp area of Belagavi.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Located in the cantonment area; access may be subject to military protocols.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Follow temple etiquette and any directions from military or site authorities.
planning_attributes.notes: The complex combines a place of worship with landscaped recreational areas.
